title: Job aspirants protest outside TGPSC office in Hyderabad over exam clash
seoTitle: Hyderabad job aspirants protest exam date clash

tea.why: Job aspirants are protesting because the TGPSC AEE exam and the central SSC JE exam are scheduled on the same date, November 6.
tea.want: Candidates are demanding an immediate revision and modification of the TGPSC examination dates.
tea.changed: Oct 17: Job aspirants staged a protest outside the TGPSC office in Nampally, Hyderabad.

summary: Job aspirants staged a protest outside the Telangana Public Service Commission (TGPSC) office in Nampally, Hyderabad, on Saturday, October 17, after two major examinations were scheduled on the same date. Protesters gathered outside the commission, chanted slogans, and faced deployment of police forces. The candidates are aggrieved that the TGPSC Assistant Executive Engineer (AEE) civil exam for the Roads and Building department clashes with the central-level Staff Selection Commission Junior Engineer (SSC JE) exam on November 6, forcing candidates to forfeit months of preparation. Protesters stated they had submitted representations to the TGPSC office over the preceding 10 days without a positive resolution. Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) leaders expressed support, urging the government to modify the schedule.
demands: Revise and modify the TGPSC exam dates to avoid clashes
response: Police were deployed at the protest site outside the TGPSC office. No official response from the commission regarding a schedule change is reported in the sources.

updates.text: Job aspirants staged a protest outside the TGPSC office in Nampally, Hyderabad, over overlapping exam dates.
